summary: Agroplant is a family-owned seed potato company based in Medemblik, Netherlands, that trades and exports seed potatoes grown under contract by Dutch growers, runs its own breeding programme and also trades ware potatoes. It dates its roots to 1924, when Klaas Molenaar started a vegetable and potato trade. It says it exports to more than fifty countries.
founded: 1924 (roots in Klaas Molenaar's vegetable and potato trade)
products: Seed potatoes grown under contract by Dutch growers
Varieties for table, traditional, fries and chips uses

plants.capacity_as_stated: Cold and freezer store with own packing station

markets: Exports to more than fifty countries
Southern Europe, North Africa and the Middle East (Margarita)
facts: About 200 growers have exclusive cultivation contracts with Agroplant
Field staff monitor more than 1,500 hectares of seed potatoes across the Netherlands
Sold more than 60,000 tonnes of seed potatoes last season (season not named)
Breeding programme run through subsidiary Fobek in Sint Annaparochie
Fourth generation of the van der Lee family became directors in 2014
